```{r}
df <- read_excel("Fidelity checklist data.xlsx")

# Here is the fidelity data Code
# Leilany 1
# Sidd 2
# Present 1
# Partially 2
# Not 3
# Football 1
# Health message 2

```

```{r}
df$Reviewer <- factor(df$Reviewer, levels = c("1", "2"))   
levels(df$Reviewer) <- c("Reviewer 1", "Reviewer 2")               

df$Session<- factor(df$Session, levels = c("1", "2"))
levels(df$Session)<- c("Football", "Health Message")

df$presence<- factor(df$presence, levels = c("1", "2", "3"))
levels(df$presence)<- c("1-Present", "2-Partially Present", "3-Not Present")
```

## Table 1: Summary Table

For each reviewer, a "Presence" of 1 was given a Fidelity score of 100%, 2 a score of 50% and 3 0%. Where there is a score from more than one reviewer, the scores are averaged.  

```{r}
df$Fidelity<-ifelse(df$presence=="1-Present", 100, 
                    ifelse(df$presence=="2-Partially Present", 50, 0))

wide_scores <- df[,-5] %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Reviewer,
    values_from = Fidelity,
    names_prefix = "Reviewer"
  ) %>%
  mutate(AvgFidelity = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("Reviewer")), na.rm = TRUE))

wide_scores$Session<- factor(wide_scores$Session, levels = c("Football", "Health Message"))
levels(wide_scores$Session)<- c("Football", "Health Message")

table_variaibles <- wide_scores %>%
  dplyr::select(
    AvgFidelity,
    Session
  )

table_variaibles %>% tbl_summary(by = Session,                          
                                 statistic = list(
                                    all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
                                    all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
                                  ),
                                  digits = all_continuous() ~ 2,
                                  missing_text = "(Missing)", 
                                 type = list(AvgFidelity ~ "continuous")) %>%
                    add_p(test = list(
                                    all_continuous() ~ "t.test",             
                                    all_categorical() ~ "chisq.test"),       
                      pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 2)) %>%       
                    add_overall(last = TRUE) %>%                             
                    modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
                    modify_spanning_header(c("stat_1", "stat_2") ~ "**Session**") %>%   
                    modify_caption("**Table 1. Average Fidelity by Session**") %>%
                    separate_p_footnotes() %>%                              
                    bold_labels()                                            
```

## Cohen's Kappa

### All Sessions

This is a measure of inter-rater reliability. Kappa = 0.908 can be interpreted as Near-Perfect agreement. Note for the methods: Linear weighting was chosen because the rating scale is ordinal. 
  
```{r}

ratings_wide <- df %>%
  select(Reviewer, Week, Session, `BCT number`, presence) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Reviewer, 
    values_from = presence
  ) %>%

  rename(Rater1 = `Reviewer 1`, Rater2 = `Reviewer 2`) %>%
  drop_na(Rater1, Rater2)

ratings_matrix <- ratings_wide %>% 
  select(Rater1, Rater2) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

kappa_result <- kappa2(ratings_matrix, weight = "equal")
print(kappa_result)
```

```{r}

ratings_wide <- df %>%
  select(Reviewer, Week, Session, `BCT number`, presence) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Reviewer, 
    values_from = presence
  ) %>%
  rename(Rater1 = `Reviewer 1`, Rater2 = `Reviewer 2`) %>%
  drop_na(Rater1, Rater2)

ratings_matrix <- ratings_wide %>% 
  select(Rater1, Rater2) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

conf_matrix <- table(Rater1 = ratings_matrix$Rater1, Rater2 = ratings_matrix$Rater2)

conf_df <- as.data.frame(conf_matrix)

ggplot(conf_df, aes(x = Rater1, y = Rater2, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), color = "white", size = 6) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f7fbff", high = "#08306b") +
  labs(title = "Reviewer Agreement Heatmap",
       subtitle = "Diagonal cells show agreement; off-diagonal show disagreement",
       x = "Reviewer 1 Rating",
       y = "Reviewer 2 Rating") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

ratings_clean <- ratings_wide %>%
  mutate(across(c(Rater1, Rater2), ~ as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", .))))

conf_df_session <- ratings_clean %>%
  group_by(Session, Rater1, Rater2) %>%
  tally(name = "Freq") %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(conf_df_session, aes(x = factor(Rater1), y = factor(Rater2), fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), color = "white", size = 5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f7fbff", high = "#08306b") +
  facet_wrap(~ Session) +
  labs(title = "Reviewer Agreement Heatmap by Session",
       subtitle = "Comparing rating distributions between Session types",
       x = "Reviewer 1 Rating",
       y = "Reviewer 2 Rating",
       fill = "Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

```

## Prevalence-Adjusted Bias-Adjusted Kappa by Session over Time

```{r}

ratings_clean <- ratings_wide %>%
  mutate(across(c(Rater1, Rater2), ~ as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", .))))

calc_pabak <- function(r1, r2) {
  tryCatch({
    levs <- c(1, 2, 3) 
    tab <- table(factor(r1, levels = levs), factor(r2, levels = levs))
    res <- epi.kappa(tab)
    return(res$pabak$est)
  }, error = function(e) return(NA))
}

kappa_data <- ratings_clean %>%
  group_by(Week, Session) %>%
  summarise(
    kappa_score = calc_pabak(Rater1, Rater2), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(kappa_data)

ggplot(kappa_data, aes(x = Week, y = kappa_score, color = factor(Session), group = Session)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE) + 
  geom_point(size = 3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.60, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(kappa_data$Week)) +
  labs(title = "Inter-rater Agreement (PABAK) by Week and Session",
       subtitle = "Prevalence-Adjusted; Corrected for categorical text",
       x = "Week",
       y = "PABAK Score",
       color = "Session") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}

ratings_with_fidelity <- df %>%
  group_by(Week, Session, `BCT number`, Reviewer) %>%
  summarise(
    presence = first(presence), 
    Fidelity = mean(Fidelity, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Reviewer, 
    values_from = presence
  ) %>%
  rename(Rater1 = `Reviewer 1`, Rater2 = `Reviewer 2`) %>%
  drop_na(Rater1, Rater2) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Rater1, Rater2), ~ as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", .))))

session_analysis <- ratings_with_fidelity %>%
  group_by(Week, Session) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(   # <--- Add 'dplyr::' here
    Avg_Fidelity = mean(Fidelity, na.rm = TRUE),
    Agreement_PABAK = calc_pabak(Rater1, Rater2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


ggplot(session_analysis, aes(x = Week, y = Avg_Fidelity, color = Session, group = Session)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(title = "Average Fidelity by Week",
       subtitle = "Football vs. Health Message delivery quality",
       y = "Fidelity Score (%)",
       x = "Study Week") +
  theme_minimal()
```
